description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git merge scenarios, including setup of commit graphs, conflict resolution, and merge failure tests.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executing the provided shell commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, asserting the failure.

methods.name: test_oid_cache
methods.description: Sets or verifies object ID cache entries.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal clock to simulate time passing.
